mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_eval_dataset (dataset_id, name, description, execution_mode, owner_user_id, status, latest_version_no, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{datasetId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{executionMode}, #{ownerUserId}, #{status}, #{latestVersionNo}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_eval_dataset WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_eval_dataset SET name=#{name}, description=#{description}, execution_mode=#{executionMode} WHERE dataset_id=#{datasetId} AND status='ACTIVE'
UPDATE ai_eval_dataset SET latest_version_no=#{latestVersionNo} WHERE dataset_id=#{datasetId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_eval_run WHERE dataset_id=#{datasetId} AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','JUDGING')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_eval_dataset_version (version_id, dataset_id, version_no, status, description, case_count, evaluator_version, evaluator_config_json, checksum, published_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{versionId}, #{datasetId}, #{versionNo}, #{status}, #{description}, #{caseCount}, #{evaluatorVersion}, #{evaluatorConfigJson}, #{checksum}, #{publishedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_eval_dataset_version WHERE version_id=#{versionId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM ai_eval_dataset_version WHERE dataset_id=#{datasetId} AND status='DRAFT' ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM ai_eval_dataset_version WHERE dataset_id=#{datasetId} ORDER BY version_no DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_eval_case (case_id, version_id, stable_key, sequence_no, conversation_group, category, tags_json, question, config_json, reference_answer, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{caseId}, #{versionId}, #{stableKey}, #{sequenceNo}, #{conversationGroup}, #{category}, #{tagsJson}, #{question}, #{configJson}, #{referenceAnswer}, #{enabled}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_eval_case WHERE case_id=#{caseId} AND version_id=#{versionId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_eval_case WHERE case_id=#{caseId} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_eval_case WHERE version_id=#{versionId} AND enabled=1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_eval_run (eval_run_id, dataset_id, version_id, version_no, name, status, execution_mode, user_id, tenant_id, selected_agent_id, memory_policy, concurrency, evaluator_version, config_snapshot_json, total_cases, completed_cases, passed_cases, failed_cases, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{evalRunId}, #{datasetId}, #{versionId}, #{versionNo}, #{name}, #{status}, #{executionMode}, #{userId}, #{tenantId}, #{selectedAgentId}, #{memoryPolicy}, #{concurrency}, #{evaluatorVersion}, #{configSnapshotJson}, #{totalCases}, #{completedCases}, #{passedCases}, #{failedCases}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_eval_run WHERE eval_run_id=#{evalRunId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_eval_run SET status='RUNNING', started_at=#{startedAt}, error_message=NULL WHERE eval_run_id=#{evalRunId} AND status='QUEUED'

UPDATE ai_eval_run r SET r.completed_cases=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_eval_case_result x WHERE x.eval_run_id=#{evalRunId} AND x.status IN ('PASS','FAIL','TIMEOUT','ERROR')), r.passed_cases=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_eval_case_result x WHERE x.eval_run_id=#{evalRunId} AND x.status='PASS'), r.failed_cases=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_eval_case_result x WHERE x.eval_run_id=#{evalRunId} AND x.status IN ('FAIL','TIMEOUT','ERROR')), r.rule_score=(SELECT AVG(x.overall_score) FROM ai_eval_case_result x WHERE x.eval_run_id=#{evalRunId} AND x.overall_score IS NOT NULL) WHERE r.eval_run_id=#{evalRunId}
UPDATE ai_eval_run SET status=#{status}, finished_at=#{finishedAt}, error_message=#{errorMessage} WHERE eval_run_id=#{evalRunId} AND (status<>'CANCELLED' OR #{status}='CANCELLED')
UPDATE ai_eval_run SET status=#{status}, error_message=#{errorMessage} WHERE eval_run_id=#{evalRunId} AND status<>'CANCELLED'
UPDATE ai_eval_run SET status='RULE_COMPLETED', error_message=NULL WHERE eval_run_id=#{evalRunId} AND status='CANCELLED' AND total_cases>0 AND completed_cases=total_cases
UPDATE ai_eval_run SET judge_score=#{judgeScore}, status=#{status} WHERE eval_run_id=#{evalRunId} AND status='JUDGING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_eval_code_version (eval_run_id, repository_name, branch_name, captured_head_sha, captured_tags_json, dirty, source_tree_hash, hash_algorithm, scope_version, ignore_rules_json, snapshot_json, binding_status, bound_tag, bound_commit_sha, matched_tags_json, binding_method, binding_note, bound_at, last_checked_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{evalRunId}, #{repositoryName}, #{branchName}, #{capturedHeadSha}, #{capturedTagsJson}, #{dirty}, #{sourceTreeHash}, #{hashAlgorithm}, #{scopeVersion}, #{ignoreRulesJson}, #{snapshotJson}, #{bindingStatus}, #{boundTag}, #{boundCommitSha}, #{matchedTagsJson}, #{bindingMethod}, #{bindingNote}, #{boundAt}, #{lastCheckedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_eval_code_version WHERE eval_run_id=#{evalRunId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_eval_code_version SET last_checked_at=#{lastCheckedAt} WHERE eval_run_id=#{evalRunId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_eval_case_result (result_id, eval_run_id, case_id, stable_key, attempt_no, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{resultId}, #{evalRunId}, #{caseId}, #{stableKey}, #{attemptNo}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_eval_case_result WHERE result_id=#{resultId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM ai_eval_case_result WHERE eval_run_id=#{evalRunId} ORDER BY created_at, id
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_eval_case_result SET status='RUNNING', agent_run_id=#{agentRunId}, session_id=#{sessionId}, started_at=#{startedAt} WHERE result_id=#{resultId} AND status='QUEUED'

UPDATE ai_eval_case_result SET status=#{status}, agent_run_id=#{agentRunId}, session_id=#{sessionId}, agent_id=#{agentId}, strategy=#{strategy}, final_answer=#{finalAnswer}, trace_json=#{traceJson}, signals_json=#{signalsJson}, route_score=#{routeScore}, answer_score=#{answerScore}, step_score=#{stepScore}, tool_score=#{toolScore}, grounding_score=#{groundingScore}, memory_score=#{memoryScore}, stability_score=#{stabilityScore}, efficiency_score=#{efficiencyScore}, safety_score=#{safetyScore}, overall_score=#{overallScore}, grade=#{grade}, warnings_json=#{warningsJson}, latency_ms=#{latencyMs}, error_message=#{errorMessage}, finished_at=#{finishedAt} WHERE result_id=#{resultId} AND status='RUNNING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_eval_judge_job (judge_job_id, eval_run_id, scope_type, status, model_id, api_id, rubric_version, config_json, total_cases, completed_cases, failed_cases, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{judgeJobId}, #{evalRunId}, #{scopeType}, #{status}, #{modelId}, #{apiId}, #{rubricVersion}, #{configJson}, #{totalCases}, #{completedCases}, #{failedCases}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_eval_judge_job WHERE judge_job_id=#{judgeJobId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM ai_eval_judge_job WHERE eval_run_id=#{evalRunId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_eval_judge_job SET status='RUNNING', total_cases=#{totalCases}, started_at=#{startedAt} WHERE judge_job_id=#{judgeJobId} AND status='QUEUED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_eval_judge_result (judge_result_id, judge_job_id, result_id, status, correctness, relevance, completeness, usefulness, safety, overall, verdict, reason, issues_json, raw_response, error_message, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{judgeResultId}, #{judgeJobId}, #{resultId}, #{status}, #{correctness}, #{relevance}, #{completeness}, #{usefulness}, #{safety}, #{overall}, #{verdict}, #{reason}, #{issuesJson}, #{rawResponse}, #{errorMessage}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_eval_judge_result WHERE judge_job_id=#{judgeJobId} ORDER BY id
